title: Design Brief: Dancing Fish Granola Berry Crunch

sections.title: Product Overview
sections.content: Dancing Fish’s Granola Berry Crunch is a high‑grain, oven‑baked granola marketed in the United States and the broader North American region. The product is sold in a 480 g recyclable paperboard carton and provides eight 85 g servings per container, delivering 166 calories per serving. It is positioned as an organic, GMO‑free, vegetarian (vegan) snack with no artificial additives and no added sugar.
sections.confidence_reason: All statements are directly supported by high‑confidence extracted facts.

sections.title: Packaging Requirements
sections.content: The primary packaging is a carton identified by code DF‑GRAN‑BERRY‑US‑001 and carries the UPC 1 20000 00003 6. Storage instructions call for a cool, dry place and resealing after opening. The package must display the recyclable paperboard symbol and the “Packaging powered by Esko” logo.
sections.confidence_reason: Packaging identifiers and required marks are explicitly listed in the source data.

sections.title: Mandatory Content
sections.content: Front‑of‑pack must list the full ingredient list, beginning with organic wholegrain oat flakes (79%) followed by almonds, pecans, walnuts, flax seeds and assorted dried berries and seeds. An allergen statement warns of possible presence of almonds, Brazil nuts, pecans, walnuts, gluten‑containing cereals and oats. The nutrition panel follows the US FDA standard vertical format and includes serving sizes (250 g, 480 g, 1000 g) with detailed macro‑ and micronutrient values, plus the standard % Daily Value disclaimer at the bottom.
sections.confidence_reason: All mandatory content elements are derived from multiple high‑confidence facts; minor uncertainty exists around the exact formatting of the nutrition panel.

sections.title: Claims & Certifications
sections.content: The product can display the claims “Certified organic,” “GMO‑free,” “Suitable for vegetarians (vegan),” “No artificial additives,” “No added sugar,” and “Oven baked.” The marketing tagline “Start tapping, swishing & shaking your tail fins!” may be used for promotional copy.
sections.confidence_reason: Claims are directly extracted from the source; certification bodies are not specified, so the claim is presented as a marketing statement.

sections.title: Design Direction
sections.content: Visual design should highlight the vibrant berry mix and nut components, using a bright, natural color palette that reinforces the organic positioning. Incorporate the recyclable paperboard mark and Esko logo subtly on the side panel. The tagline can appear on the front or back to convey the playful brand personality.
sections.confidence_reason: Design cues are based on the provided marketing text and mandatory marks.

uncertainty: Legal name/statement of identity, specific allergen label formatting requirements, exact layout specifications for the FDA nutrition panel, verification of organic certification authority, and placement guidelines for the barcode are not defined in the sources.
